TestDeleteInsert::test_delete_insert_sea.description: 2 DCs x 2 racks x 1 node, NTS RF dc1:2 dc2:2, table with secondary index on `group`. Inserts 1000 rows in 4 random groups, deletes all group2 rows by PK (IN batches of 100), re-inserts them, then runs 20 parallel LOCAL_QUORUM `SELECT ... WHERE group='group2'` from random nodes expecting the count to equal the re-inserted rows. Guards SI correctness after delete + re-insert of the same keys (Cassandra CASSANDRA-5510 port); in scylla this exercises MV-based index view updates (tombstone vs re-insert shadowing).

origin.summary: Ryan McGuire, Cassandra dtest 'Adds delete_insert_test from CASSANDRA-5510' (forced C* 1.2.5); inherited from Cassandra dtest, not scylla-specific.
